items.title: MuleSoft Integration Platform
items.what_text: MuleSoft confirmed absent from 200+ platform profile [:F1-F3]. Azure Logic Apps is sole integration tool handling point-to-point connections across Jack Henry Symitar, Blend, Genesys, Alkami, and 10+ platforms. Pre-built Symitar connectors on AppExchange exist but are not deployed [:F3]. Legacy platforms (Win2000/2003/XP, Citrix, WebSphere) compound integration complexity [:F9]. MuleSoft Anypoint Platform connected unlock: improvement above 2.5 removes cap at 3.0 — unlocking automation maturity. In Zennify's assessment Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scores 1.5 out of 5, versus a typical 3.0 at comparable institutions [E-066].
items.why_text: The assessment found: “BCU uses Jack Henry Symitar Core since 1999, cloud-migrated, renewed partnership 2025 CTO Scott Zulpo: shifted from infrastructure management to innovation via cloud” [E-004]. At 1.5 out of 5, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) sits 1.5 points below the 3.0 typically seen at comparable institutions — an early-stage capability with the widest distance to close. Closing that distance would strengthen the data and technology foundation the rest of the business is built on, so progress here compounds across the rest of the business.
